name: zsoftly-dot-github
description: ZSoftly organization profile and shared GitHub defaults

scripts.profile:check: test -f profile/assets/zsoftly-github-banner.svg && test -f profile/assets/zsoftly-github-avatar.svg && test -f profile/assets/zsoftly-github-avatar-1024x1024.png && grep -Fq './assets/zsoftly-github-banner.svg' profile/README.md && grep -Fq 'https://zcp.zsoftly.ca/' profile/README.md && grep -Fq 'https://docs.zcp.zsoftly.ca/' profile/README.md && grep -Fq 'https://cloud.zcp.zsoftly.ca/' profile/README.md
